title: Feature-flagged Private Deploy Launch: Release Notes Orchestration & Compliance Attestation
creator: Alexandra Kim
description: Coordinate cross-team launch for Private/VPC/on-prem RBAC, audit-logs, and KMS features using a feature-flagged rollout. Deliver machine-readable and customer-facing release notes, compliance attestation artifacts for enterprise customers, and a gated enablement flow for early adopter accounts. Ensure Console, SDKs, Docs, and Billing reflect feature states before public release.
acceptance_criteria: Feature flags enabled in control plane and gate checks added to Console and API
RBAC role mappings documented and validated with two enterprise test customers
Audit log ingestion verified end-to-end and retention policy documented
KMS integration validated with AWS KMS and HashiCorp Vault in VPC tests
Release notes published in both human-readable and machine-parsable changelog formats
Support runbook and escalations page published; PagerDuty rotation updated
Security/compliance attestation pack available for customer download
action_items: PM: finalize release note templates and machine-readable changelog schema by 2025-03-03
Docs: create RBAC, Audit Logs, and KMS walkthroughs and code samples (due 2025-03-06)
Engineering: land feature-flag gating in control plane + Console PRs (ENG-4921, ENG-5010, ENG-5088)
Security: complete compliance attestation draft and internal review (due 2025-03-08)
Support: prepare triage playbook and update runbook with SLOs and known issues
Sales/CS: prepare account checklist and target 5 canary customers for opt-in testing
updates: 2025-02-18: Ticket created — initial scoping with Eng, Docs, Security. Decided on feature-flagged rollout to reduce blast radius.
2025-02-21: Eng requested additional API gating for backward compatibility; moved one acceptance criterion to 'blocking' until API contract signed.
2025-02-26: Docs submitted first draft and requested sample customer scripts for KMS rotation patterns.
2025-03-01: Security review kickoff — identified two compliance artifacts required for EU data residency customers.
2025-03-03: Release note schema approved; added automated changelog ingestion pipeline to docs CI (PR linked).
2025-03-04: Confirmed two canary customers for opt-in; scheduled dry-run validation next week.
notes: Unique focus for this launch: split release notes into technical (for integrators and SREs) and business-facing summaries for account teams; also publish a machine-readable changelog that powers the Console's 'What's changed' panel and automated upgrade diff checks for Private customers.
rollout_strategy: Phase 0: Internal dogfood in staging (control plane + Console feature flags on) — immediate
Phase 1: 5 canary enterprise customers opt-in via account teams — 2 weeks
Phase 2: Gradual expansion to customers with Dedicated contracts via beta opt-in — 3 additional weeks
Phase 3: Public enablement toggle and GA announcement after 6-week validation and zero-critical-bugs SLA met
release_notes_plan: Create human-friendly 'What changed' and 'How it affects you' sections per feature (RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS)
Publish machine-readable changelog (JSON) with keys: component, breaking_changes, migration_steps, upgrade_risks
Automate insertion of SDK/Console links and sample curl snippets in release notes via docs CI
Coordinate with Marketing for customer-facing launch email; finalize copy and send window 48 hours after GA decision
Prepare pre-registered FAQs for Account Execs to surface in first customer outreach
enablement_plan: Enablement webinar for Sales + SEs: 1.5 hour session with live demo and troubleshooting scenarios
Office hours schedule for first 2 weeks post-GA with Engineering on-call present
Quickstart template (GitHub) for customers to enable RBAC and configure KMS in a VPC
Training doc for Support with decision trees and log locations for audit log issues
Certification pack (PDF) for customers requiring compliance artefacts including SOC2 sections and KMS key lifecycle notes
metrics_and_kpis: Adoption: percent of targeted canary accounts that enable feature within 14 days (target >= 60%)
Stability: < 1 P0 incident per 100 customer-days during Phase 1
Latency: no regression >5% for control-plane API calls after RBAC enforcement
Support: median time-to-first-response < 30 minutes for enablement tickets during first week
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: RBAC misconfiguration could lock customers out — Mitigation: soft-fail mode and account-scoped emergency bypass token
Risk: Audit logs increase storage cost for customers — Mitigation: document retention controls and default retention policy with opt-out guidance
Risk: KMS misconfiguration causing unavailable cryptographic keys — Mitigation: preflight checks, key rotation runbook, and automated alerts to customer admin
qa_plan: End-to-end tests with simulated VPC environments (AWS and GCP)
Chaos test: simulate control plane latency and confirm fallback policies for read-only operations
Compliance smoke tests: generate attestation artifacts for two EU customers and verify contents
Manual UX pass for Console flows: enable/disable feature flag, KMS binding, audit log search
post_launch_tasks: 1-week retrospective with Eng, Docs, Security, and Support to capture learnings
Turn on public GA banner and move docs from beta to GA status
Update billing docs if necessary for audit-log storage or KMS usage
Collect telemetry dashboard snapshots and publish to execs
